label: Claude with GSD (Get Shit Done)
install: set -e; mkdir -p ~/.local; curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.12.0/node-v22.12.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C ~/.local --strip-components=1; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
run: set -e; npx -y get-shit-done-cc --claude --local > /dev/null; { printf '/gsd:quick '; cat "$SWE_PROMPT"; printf '\nWork without asking questions: no one will answer. Take the recommended choice at each point.\n'; } | claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode bypassPermissions ${SWE_MODEL:+--model "$SWE_MODEL"}
fired: any(.type == "system" and .subtype == "init" and ((.slash_commands // []) | any(tostring | test("gsd")))) and any(.type == "result" and (.is_error | not))
